remarks: Spacious 1-bedroom in one of Norwalk's premier condo complexes!!! Tucked away in a beautiful suburban setting yet located right around the corner from Route 7 and the Merritt for an easy commute! This second floor unit features an oversized bedroom with ample closet space and lots of natural light. Washer/dryer located in-unit and tons of guest parking in the complex. Come home after a day's work and relax by the pool, the picnic space, or the tranquil on-site pond! Heat and Hot Water included in rent, as well as an additional storage unit in adjacent building. Schedule your appointment today - this one won't last long!
